reviews.shade: [Mermaid EDITION] dasique Shine Glowy Highlighter Palette 5.5g 01 Twinkle Mermaid
reviews.text: GORGEOUS!! i love the texture and glow, it's more pearlescent than chunky glitter. i'm a sucker for mermaid/ocean themed items too so this was perfect. i wish it wasnt limited edition cos i dont want it to run out
reviews.zh: 超靚！！我好鍾意佢嘅質地同光澤，比較似珍珠光，唔係大粒閃粉咁。我自己對人魚／海洋主題嘅嘢完全冇抵抗力，所以呢盒啱晒我。真希望佢唔係限定版，因為我唔想用晒佢。

reviews.shade: [Mermaid EDITION] dasique Shine Glowy Highlighter Palette 5.5g 01 Twinkle Mermaid
reviews.text: I LOVE this palette! It's a very wearable kind of glitter but still sparkly enough to be eye-catching. Not chunky at all. And I love the purple shimmer in some of the shades, giving a duochrome vibe
reviews.zh: 我超鍾意呢盒眼影！係好實戴嘅閃粉，但又閃得夠搶眼。完全唔會一嚿嚿。我仲好鍾意幾個色入面帶紫色偏光，營造出雙色調嘅感覺。

reviews.shade: [Mermaid EDITION] dasique Shine Glowy Highlighter Palette 5.5g 01 Twinkle Mermaid
reviews.text: This is a beautiful palette! I’ve had my eye on it for a while and I’m glad I decided to get it! The colors are so soft and sit beautifully on the skin. The top two and bottom left shades all look pretty similar with small differences. If you’re looking for a highlighting palette with lots of variation, this might not be your cup of tea, but if you like pink highlighters, look no further!
reviews.zh: 呢盒真係好靚！我一直留意緊佢，好開心最後決定買咗。隻隻顏色都好柔和，上皮膚效果好好。上面兩格同左下角嗰隻睇落幾乎一樣，只係有少少分別。如果你想要變化多端嘅打亮盤，呢盒未必啱你；但如果你鍾意粉紅色打亮，揀呢盒就冇錯！

reviews.shade: [Mermaid EDITION] dasique Shine Glowy Highlighter Palette 5.5g 01 Twinkle Mermaid
reviews.text: Pretty palette but the texture is chalky! It doesn't spread as easily and settle in fine lines. The shine is nice though. Overall, not bad!
reviews.zh: 眼影盤幾靚，但質地好粉！唔係好容易推開，而且會卡入細紋。光澤感幾好。整體嚟講，都唔差！

reviews.shade: [Mermaid EDITION] dasique Shine Glowy Highlighter Palette 5.5g 01 Twinkle Mermaid
reviews.text:
パッケージからもうかわいさが溢れてるハイライターパレット。白系からピンク系までそろっていて、透明感のあるツヤ感が出せるハイライターです。ラメは小さめで繊細だから、ギラギラしすぎずどこにでも使いやすいのが本当に優秀。ハイライト初心者さんでも使いやすいと思います。なんと言っても塗りやすさが抜群で、サッと塗ってもムラにならないのが嬉しいポイント。粉っぽさが全くなくて肌にしっとり密着してくれるので、浮かないし、密着力も高くて崩れる心配もないです。
本当に可愛くて可愛くて最高です！！！
reviews.zh:
由包裝已經散發出滿滿可愛感嘅打亮盤。由白色調到粉紅色調都有，可以化出透明感嘅光澤。閃粉細緻唔誇張，去邊都用得，呢一點真係好優秀。就算係打亮初學者都好容易掌握。最重要係超級易塗，隨手一抹都唔會有斑斑浮粉。完全冇粉感，緊貼肌膚，唔會浮起，密著力強，唔使擔心溶妝。
真係可愛到爆，無得輸！！！

reviews.shade: [Mermaid EDITION] dasique Shine Glowy Highlighter Palette 5.5g 01 Twinkle Mermaid
reviews.text: Honestly so beautiful. I love the shimmer it gives to my makeup. The only odd thing about it is the fact thaat it is not a dusty highlighter but a almost creamy feel to it. Sometimes I'm not sure how to use with my makeup.
reviews.zh: 講真，超靚。好鍾意佢帶俾我妝容嘅閃光感。唯一有啲怪嘅係，佢唔係粉狀打亮，而係接近霜狀嘅觸感。有時我唔太清楚應該點樣同其他妝品一齊用。

reviews.shade: [Mermaid EDITION] dasique Shine Glowy Highlighter Palette 5.5g 01 Twinkle Mermaid
reviews.text: I love this highlighter! It blends so well and is the perfect pinky/clear highlight to your face! It gives a pretty glow that is really trendy in Korea. It's not a powder consistency but in between a cream and powder finish (it has a little bounce when you tap into it)
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢個打亮！超級易推開，係最完美嘅粉紅／透明感打亮！化出嚟個光澤好靚，喺韓國而家好流行。佢唔係純粉狀，而係介乎霜狀同粉狀之間（用手指輕拍會有少少彈性）。

reviews.shade: [Mermaid EDITION] dasique Shine Glowy Highlighter Palette 5.5g 01 Twinkle Mermaid
reviews.text: The product itself is beautiful, super buttery to the touch. However, mine comes right off the pan. I have to be careful and try to press it back into the pan which doesn’t look pretty so beware of that
reviews.zh: 產品本身好靚，觸感好滑順。不過我嗰盒一撳就成塊甩出嚟。要好小心咁用，仲要試下按返入去，但壓得唔靚，所以要留意呢一點。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
